notablePrerequisites:
Scythe of the Wretched attached to Orchard Strider.
You control at least two Foods.
description:
Activate Asmoranomardicadaistinaculdacar by sacrificing two Foods, causing Orchard Strider to deal six damage to itself.
Orchard Strider dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Scythe of the Wretched triggers, returning Orchard Strider from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Scythe of the Wretched to it.
When Orchard Strider enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two Food tokens.
Repeat.
